_comment: ops/seo/tasks.json -- scheduled task definitions. Task Scheduler only ever passes a task NAME to run-task.ps1; every hyphenated flag lives here, because passing '--dry-run' through 'powershell.exe -File' is unreliable (an outer PowerShell expands it character by character into '- - d r y - r u n'). Keeping arguments in this file removes that failure mode entirely.

bing-coverage.description: Bing GetUrlInfo per-URL coverage over a prioritised queue (_bing_queue.json): product pages plus locale hub pages first (509), then a 1-in-5 fixed-stride sample (522). Measured 2026-10-19: 1 req/s exhausts the token bucket at request 19, but 1 req/5s sustained 464 requests before throttling, so pacing rather than the daily count is the lever. --limit 400 at --interval 5 walks the queue down to whatever the bucket allows and stops cleanly. Throttling is recorded as a measurement failure, never as not-indexed.

seo-daily.description: Daily submission: Google sitemap, Bing/Nave/Seznam IndexNow, plus the daily report draft. Currently disabled.

seo-email.description: Sends the daily report by SMTP. Runs the morning after the draft. Currently disabled.

gsc-daily.description: GSC URL-inspection batch plus merge into the Coverage workbook. Runs at 07:25; Google's browser-UI inspection quota stops it early.

gsc-dryrun.description: Validation only: checks that gsc_run.mjs can reach its inputs without launching a browser.

gsc-index.description: Request indexing in the GSC UI for URLs Google has not indexed. Uses the signed-in browser profile, so no OAuth and no GCP billing. The inspection quota resets at midnight Pacific (about 15:00-16:00 Beijing); when it is exhausted GSC shows a modal that covers the whole page, so the script dismisses it, probes availability, and exits 2 with the reset time rather than retrying uselessly. Run it again after the reset to continue with whatever is left. '--file' paths resolve against DSH_DATA_DIR.
